== R Smith = Reid Smith (2026-10-20) ==
* The 2010 Worlds Day 2 sheets (pp103–104) are printed "R Smith" with username 3MW0J8; the 2011 Worlds Day 2 sheets (pp13–14) carry the same name, hand and username. The 2009 MPC pre-registration list (forum t=22347, 9 August 2008) has "40 - Reid Smith - PA 3MW0J8". The 2010 Day 2 final standings (forum t=37391, post p572198) list "25. Reid Smith 8 +2". The 25th-place finish goes in the table once the Wayback copy of the t=37391 snapshot exists (queued 20 October). [[Reid Smith|R Smith]] and the 2010 "R Smith" deck page already redirect here.
* The 2011 rows cited the forum index f=565; they now cite the 2011 Worlds Day 2 and Day 3 PDFs (Day 2 pp13–14, Day 3 pp5–6).
